title: MediaCore and first-party playback
objective: Deliver the shared MediaCore, SQLite/FTS5 runtime state, local media, NanoTube integration, IPTV/EPG and the bounded file/download flows required by the MVP.
constraints: mpv is a subprocess controlled through JSON IPC in V1.
XMLTV is parsed incrementally and never loaded as one in-memory document.
NanoTube-specific resolution/auth/catalog logic remains outside the Shell.
acceptance: mpv JSON IPC backend supports play/pause/seek/tracks/volume/stop with cancellation and failure recovery.
SQLite/FTS5 stores history, favorites, library metadata and search without resident heavy indexers.
IPTV imports Extended M3U and XMLTV via streaming parse and launches channels through MediaCore.
Continue Watching works across at least local media and NanoTube integration.
File/download screens support Downloads, Videos, Music, Games, USB and progress without becoming a general desktop file manager.
SQLite migrations cover history, resume, favorites, metadata, channels and EPG.

history.reason: Roadmap outcome defined; acceptance may be amended before LOCKED.
P03 scope reconciled with the canonical MVP and MediaCore contracts are ready.
Playback, persistence and parser implementation proceeds with host fixtures.
